description: This file defines a handler class for approving savings account applications within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the processCommand method which delegates the approval process to a dedicated service.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles approval commands for savings account applications by delegating to a service layer.

methods.name: SavingsAccountApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the service responsible for processing savings application approvals.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the approval command by invoking the approveApplication method on the write platform service with the command data.
